Record S11's review round 1: failed undo, work item #12

in a1f08bc7b; the crash window it leaves, which needs a settlement

title: Let a trade whose undo fails stand, instead of reporting it undone
message:
Let a trade whose undo fails stand, instead of reporting it undone

Review of MR !17: when a cargo trade committed, the captain's save
failed, and the undo could not be recorded either, cargobuy and
cargosell still restored the gold and the hold in memory and said the
trade was undone, while the database kept it: quotes used the traded
supply, and a reload before the next manifest write brought back unpaid
cargo or dropped a cancelled sale.

trade_settle() now moves the gold, saves it, and undoes the trade on a
failed save, reporting it undone only once the undo is recorded. If
the undo fails too, the trade stands as recorded, in memory too, and the
persistence service's minute save stores the gold once it can. Both
commands use it. The crash window that remains needs a settlement
record and a player-file marker: work item #12.

title: Record cargo trades before the gold moves, and save the gold checked
message:
Record cargo trades before the gold moves, and save the gold checked

cargobuy and cargosell moved gold in memory only and wrote the port's
supply and the manifest unchecked, outside a transaction: a crash before
the captain's next save returned a buyer's gold with the cargo aboard or
lost a seller's gold with the cargo gone, and a failed manifest write
left sold cargo recorded aboard, to be sold again after a reboot.

trade_record() now writes the supply and the manifest in one
transaction, replacing port_adjust_supply() (its UPDATE is a prepared
statement now). The gold moves only after that commits, and is saved
with save_char_checked(); if the save fails, the gold and the hold are
restored and the old supply and manifest recorded again. A sale trains
the crew only once it is saved.

title: Plan S11: checked cargo trades (work item #10)
message:
Plan S11: checked cargo trades (work item #10)

cargobuy and cargosell move gold in memory and write the manifest and
port supply unchecked, outside a transaction. The plan gives both the
shape freight acceptance took in a703572e3: the trade recorded in one
transaction, the gold moved after it commits and saved checked, and a
failed save undone.

title: Add S11 and S12 for work items #10 and #11
message:
Add S11 and S12 for work items #10 and #11

Two follow-ups join the vessel sequence, both resolved in this

save (work item #10), and S12 gives shared waypoints and routes a
creator so only they and staff may delete them (work item #11). S11 is
